intro.title: About us
paragraphs: Kompass Kollektive brings together projects by Nina and Masha. Last year they launched Water for All — a map of free drinking water sources in Berlin.

Ahead of the election, Nina started figuring out who to vote for. She read the party programs, built a comparison table, and wrote about climate and transport policy across parties. She showed the table to Masha, who suggested turning it into a website and designed the whole UI. That is how a clear, practical tool came to life — Berlin 2026.

Water for All is a grassroots initiative dedicated to making information about free drinking water sources in Berlin accessible to everyone. The project was born out of the Lab for Political Participation program by Club Dialog e.V. and has since evolved into an independent initiative.
The Lab for Political Participation is a Club Dialog e.V. program designed to empower Russian-speaking Berliners with migration backgrounds to strengthen their civic and political engagement.

Berlin 2026 is an independent project comparing party programs ahead of the 2026 Berlin state election. Official programs are published only in German — we translate them into languages spoken in Berlin. Nina compares the programs and develops the project; Masha handles the technical side.
